en_title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Movie Is So Popular, It Increased RE2 Remake Sales by More Than 50% on PS5
cn_title: 《生化危机》电影带动重制版销量
subtitle: 电影带火游戏
opus_summary: Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》电影上映后，《生化危机2》与《生化危机4》重制版在PS5上的销量分别增长64%和54%。两款游戏的活跃玩家数量也明显上升，但卡普空此前已大幅降价。

paragraphs.en: Data shows that Zach Cregger’s film adaptation of Capcom’s flagship horror franchise was so successful, it boosted sales for copies of both Resident Evil 2 Remake and RE4’s 2023 remake on the PlayStation 5.
paragraphs.cn: 数据显示，Zach Cregger执导的卡普空旗舰恐怖游戏系列改编电影大获成功，带动《生化危机2》重制版和2023年推出的《生化危机4》重制版在PS5上的销量增长。

paragraphs.en: Cregger’s Resident Evil has enjoyed resounding success on all fronts; not only is it the single most-profitable Resident Evil movie ever made, it’s also helping sales for the games it’s based on.
paragraphs.cn: Cregger执导的《生化危机》在各方面都取得了巨大成功。这不仅是有史以来盈利最高的《生化危机》电影，也带动了作为其改编基础的游戏销量。

paragraphs.en: Stats aggregated by Alinea Analytics show that the Resident Evil 2 Remake and Resident Evil 4 (2023) enjoyed a massive boost in the week after Cregger’s movie hit theaters. As told in a substack post written by Alinea Analytics’ Rhys Elliot, RE2 remake and RE 4 (2023) enjoyed a whopping 64% and 54% increase in PS5 sales, respectively. With Steam copies added to the mix, the games got bumped up by an additional 11% and 14%, respectively.
paragraphs.cn: Alinea Analytics汇总的数据表明，Cregger执导的电影上映后一周，《生化危机2》重制版和《生化危机4》（2023）的销量大幅增长。Alinea Analytics的Rhys Elliot在一篇发布于Substack的文章中写道，两款游戏在PS5上的销量分别增长了64%和54%。如果把Steam版本也计算在内，两款游戏的销量还分别额外增长了11%和14%。

paragraphs.en: On PlayStation, this means the two games’ revenue increased by a jaw-dropping 80% and 84%, though it’s also worth noting that Capcom slashed prices for the games about 10 days before Cregger’s movie hit theaters.
paragraphs.cn: 在PlayStation平台上，两款游戏的收入分别增长了惊人的80%和84%。不过需要注意的是，卡普空在Cregger执导的电影上映前约10天就下调了游戏售价。

paragraphs.en: Elliot points out that, while deep discounts made up for most of these impressive numbers beforehand, Austin Abrams’ deeply relatable performance as Bryan moved the needle quite a bit in the week afterwards, which also translated to increased player numbers.
paragraphs.cn: Elliot指出，虽然此前的大幅折扣已经贡献了这些亮眼数据中的大部分，但Austin Abrams饰演的Bryan极具共鸣的表现，还是在电影上映后一周明显推动了销量增长，同时也带来了更多玩家。

paragraphs.en: Daily active users across several major Resident Evil titles increased after September 18, with RE2R having the largest surge at 48%, jumping from ~78K to ~116K daily players. This makes sense, given that Cregger’s film takes place parallel to the events of this particular game.
paragraphs.cn: 9月18日之后，多款主要《生化危机》游戏的日活跃用户数均有所增加。其中，《生化危机2》重制版的涨幅最大，达到48%，每日玩家数从约78,000人增至约116,000人。考虑到Cregger执导的电影与这款游戏的事件平行展开，这一结果并不意外。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil 4 (2023) players increased 24%, Resident Evil 3 Remake jumped up 25%, and Resident Evil Requiem saw a 20% increase in active players. Requiem also recently passed $500 million in total lifetime revenue , with a whopping 91% of sales for the game happening across PlayStation and Steam. In fact, this particular game drove PlayStation and PC sales in Japan within the first half of 2026, increasing by 13% to 21 million copies sold.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机4》（2023）的玩家数增长了24%，《生化危机3》重制版增长了25%，《生化危机：安魂曲》的活跃玩家数则增加了20%。《生化危机：安魂曲》近期的累计总收入也已超过5亿美元(约合人民币34亿元)，其中高达91%的销量来自PlayStation和Steam。事实上，这款游戏推动了2026年上半年日本市场的PlayStation和PC销量，使销量增长13%，达到2,100万份。

paragraphs.en: With the Code Veronica remake on the horizon, Resident Evil fans are getting fed by the Capgods, who have similarly enjoyed a wonderful year with three highly rated game releases. Onimusha: Way of the Sword was critically acclaimed upon launch, and Pragmata surprised critics and casual players alike with its innovative gameplay and tear-jerking story.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《生化危机：代号维罗妮卡》重制版即将到来，《生化危机》粉丝正不断迎来卡普空的新作。卡普空今年同样凭借三款获得高评价的游戏表现出色。《鬼武者：剑之道》发售后广受好评，《Pragmata》则凭借创新玩法和催人泪下的故事，同时令媒体和休闲玩家感到惊喜。

paragraphs.en: For more Resident Evil news, check out this viral behind-the-scenes footage of stunt performers who worked on Cregger’s film, showing how they brought its main stalker monster to life. You can also read our interview with Cregger here , where he admits that he was “naive” to think hardcore fans would be pleased with him avoiding a direct adaptation of the games — though those box office numbers seem to be telling a different story.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受采访时，Cregger承认，自己以为避开直接改编游戏就能让核心粉丝满意，这种想法「太天真了」。不过，电影的票房数据似乎讲述了另一个故事。
